verdict.rationale: The only nearby evidence is a help-center category listing '定时任务' (scheduled tasks), which is a time-based schedule. It is not user-defined rules that fire actions automatically on events, so it counts only as an adjacent feature. Nothing in the pack documents event triggers, rule definitions, or event-driven automation for Kimi, Kimi Code, or the API platform.
